Context: - Section 80-D

- (j) If an assessee has taken any loan from any financial institution or charitable institution for purpose of his higher education or higher education of spouse / children or for a student to whom the assessee is a legal guardian, the amount of interest paid during the year can be deducted from the taxable income till the loan including interest is cleared or for a period of eight years, whichever is earlier. - Section 80-E
